title: GlowSMP Season 2
description: The modpack for the GlowSMP, a 1920s-themed roleplay server.
body:
This is the modpack for GlowSMP Season Two, a whitelist-only roleplay server based in the 1920s era. Some prominent mods include:

Create mod - build factories, contraptions, trains, and more!

MCA Reborn - fully integrated NPCs around the city

Musket Mod - Spice up combat with some balanced, functional guns

and much more!
